_date_modified: DERIVED, NOT AUTHORED. The JSON-LD dateModified is computed by build.js from the newest modification time across this spec folder, template/ and the order file — the three things that actually change the rendered page. It used to be hand-typed here as 2026-09-01 while the approved build was 2026-09-05, which is exactly the failure completion-plan item 4 (P0) names. Putting a literal date_modified key back in this file is now a BUILD FAILURE, on purpose. Never type a date.
